summary: Galiano Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a June 2, 2026 news release. The release announces that ISS and Glass Lewis recommend shareholders vote FOR all proposed resolutions at the upcoming Annual General and Special Meeting. The meeting will fix director count at eight, elect directors, reappoint auditor, approve an equity incentive plan, and approve an advisory vote on executive compensation. This is a routine AGM proxy solicitation update, not a special situation. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or activist engagement is disclosed. The board unanimously recommends voting FOR, with a proxy deadline of June 9, 2026.
